responsibility: Shared implementation support used by all Objective-C runtime back ends. It builds common tree templates and initializers for structs such as objc_super, methods, ivars, lists, and module descriptors; provides helpers for struct/field creation, variable declaration/finalization, selector and string-pool construction, protocol-reference generation, and emission of consolidated metadata string tables; and stores the runtime metadata tag trees used by NeXT-style section labeling.
same_name_distinction: Common runtime-support implementation file: it defines the shared helper routines declared in objc-runtime-shared-support.h for constructing metadata structs, declarations, selector tables, ivar metadata, protocol references, and emitted string objects. Unlike the header, it contains the code that builds and finalizes those runtime data structures.
